mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for AI search optimization services for a law firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for AI search optimization services for a law firm varies widely based on the scope of work, the firm's current online presence, and desired outcomes. Factors include the number of practice areas, geographic targeting, and whether services involve comprehensive content strategy, technical SEO, or local SEO. Fees can range from a few hundred dollars per month for basic services to several thousand for extensive, ongoing campaigns. Most providers offer custom quotes after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for AI search optimization for law firms vary significantly, depending on service scope and firm size, ranging from hundreds to thousands of dollars monthly.
